description:
Turn on a folder's share link: share_url is a public read-only page anyone with it
    opens signed out (hookdetector.com/f/<token>); api_url is the same as JSON
    (get_shared_folder). It shows the folder's name, description and items with their
    notes, never anything about the account. A shared folder keeps its link. Same as
    POST /v1/folders/{folder_id}/share. Free.

folder_id.description: one of your folders (from list_folders or create_folder)
folder_id.title: Folder Id

name: share_folder
